summary: Redesigned the Case files screen, which had rendered into `.panel`/`.panel-head` classes with no CSS rules anywhere in the stylesheet and so looked unstyled. It is now a proper `.workspace cases-page` screen with a dismissible four-step guide ('How a case works': open a case, add the evidence, the footage is held, export then close) that deep-links into the matching manual article anchors, a clickable progress rail on the open case (Opened / Evidence / Write-up / Outcome, pressing Outcome opens the close dialog), a four-tile stat strip (Evidence, Clips held, clips only still present because the case is holding them, footage already gone), a search box and Open/Closed/All filter with counts, and card rows with assignee initials. Empty states now name the screen the evidence came from (Timeline, Objects, Notifications, Add note) instead of a generic 'nothing here'. Along with the redesign, six real bugs shipped in the old screen were fixed: the evidence row's Play button called a callback the app never passed in and silently did nothing - there is now an in-page player that fetches the segment and seeks to the marked moment; the case dialogs inherited the video player's hardcoded dark background, so light-theme text was near-black on near-black with no padding; a global `button.active` style made the selected list row's own title invisible; the pending Outcome step drew a checkmark next to 'Still open'; the footage-hold panel showed a reassuring green message on a case holding zero clips; and switching cases kept the previous case's already-built export bundle on screen instead of clearing it. `tools/fleetbench/uicheck_cases.js` was updated to match the new markup (`.cases-page` instead of `.cases-panel`, and the primary action button instead of the first button in the row, which is now Cancel).
compatibility: Frontend-only; no API, schema, or config change. Existing cases, evidence, exports and audit trail entries are unaffected and read identically under the new screen. The guide's dismissed/shown state is remembered per browser in localStorage (`mymatasan.cases.guide`); a browser that blocks storage simply shows the guide every visit rather than failing. New i18n keys were added to en/ms/zh/ar; no existing key was renamed or removed.
